description: Apache Airflow connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's data-orchestration DAGs from a self-hosted Airflow instance as `airflow:dag` items in the local index — the dag_id, paused/active flags, owners, description, schedule interval, tags, source file location, next scheduled run, and last-parsed timestamp. Useful for answering orchestration questions ("which DAGs are paused?", "what's the schedule for the nightly ETL?") without leaving Nimbus. Airflow HTTP Basic auth (username + password). Airflow has no universal SaaS host: the server host is supplied via the airflow base-url vault key and added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by phase3AddAirflowMcp, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty. The stable REST API v1 /api/v1/dags endpoint paginates by limit / offset with a total_entries count in the response body; the connector walks a single forward offset pass per cycle, capped. v1 indexes DAG definitions only — individual DAG runs and task instances are a deferred follow-up. No write tools.
author: Nimbus
